text: The city council approved a $2.3 million budget increase for public transit, citing rising ridership numbers and aging infrastructure that requires immediate attention.
Researchers at Stanford published findings showing that daily meditation for 20 minutes reduces cortisol levels by 23% over a six-week period in adults aged 30-50.
The new electric vehicle factory in Tennessee will create approximately 4,000 jobs and is expected to produce 300,000 vehicles annually starting in 2027.
A bipartisan group of senators introduced legislation requiring social media companies to verify the age of users and restrict algorithmic content recommendations for minors.
Global wheat prices fell 12% this quarter following record harvests in Australia and Argentina, easing concerns about food inflation in developing nations.
The school district voted to implement a four-day school week starting next fall, with Friday designated as an independent study day for students in grades 6-12.
NASA's latest Mars rover discovered mineral deposits consistent with ancient lake beds, strengthening the hypothesis that liquid water existed on Mars for millions of years.
The state supreme court ruled that gig economy workers are entitled to unemployment insurance, potentially affecting over 200,000 drivers and delivery workers statewide.

A clinical trial of 1,200 patients showed the new Alzheimer's drug slowed cognitive decline by 35% compared to placebo over 18 months, though side effects included brain swelling in 12% of participants.
The city's new congestion pricing program reduced downtown traffic by 18% in its first month, generating $45 million in revenue earmarked for subway improvements.
